description: Check that a wallet can receive referral fees. There is no registration: a partner is just a Solana wallet address, set on this server with XSTOCKER_PARTNER_WALLET. USDC fees land in the wallet's USDC token account (it must exist), SOL fees in the wallet itself. Only use if the user asks about becoming a partner.

wallet.description: The user's Solana wallet address (public address only, never a private key)

name: check_partner
title: Check a referral partner wallet
